releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.16.3 - Instant Foreground Window Activation & Tray Fix:
- Window Visibility & Activation: Fixed single-instance mutex blocking foreground launch, added WM_SHOW_SUITE IPC broadcast and WS_MINIMIZEBOX window styling for instant on-screen popup.
- Tray Interaction: Single-click and double-click on system tray icon now immediately brings the main dashboard to the front and activates it.
- Fully populated all 6 tabs with Google Stitch OLED Neon Precision styling.
